versions.name: Base N Percentage
versions.description: Turns the percentage into any Base n

about:
You can change your percentage to any base n! (less than 64 and greater than 2, with neN)  
Example, base 64 turns "99%" into "FF%". 100% is always 100% in whatever base you choose.  
Have fun :D
